active_task.title: Stabilize released Search 2.0 on main, then release factual DS2 footer
required_gates: targeted bundle-aware browser QA at 375px and 1440px for Search 2.0 defects
Deploy anytoour.ru + narrow production smoke for merged Search 2.0 fixes
factual footer: Security guard + existing DS2-aware footer visual gate + branch-bundle QA
evidence: Search 2.0 activation released to main through PR #761 as d142777f73209c79b2e609ea26b2d82e4650643e; no bulk feature/search-core merge was used.

After activation, a real desktop overflow was reproduced at 1440px: results toolbar x=724..1630 because DS2 added margin-left 274px after the legacy shell had already placed it in the second grid column.

PR #767 removed only the redundant desktop toolbar offset/forced width. Bundle-aware browser QA is green at 375/768/1024/1440, with Security and targeted V2 validation green; main merge SHA e98af23816a5052e0fc6fec769474426dbdc6932.

The old Visual V2 baseline does not inject bundle-managed PR CSS and therefore cannot be the primary verification owner for ds2-search.css-only PRs; its stale overflow result is classified as verification wiring, not a product regression.

PR #763 repaired the existing footer visual workflow instead of adding another workflow. It now validates legacy or accepted DS2 footer structure, exact factual destinations, overflow and >=44px mobile targets; main merge SHA f392e4047cb36d527f9ee10266794bc2fdb2dbdc.

Factual DS2 footer release was recreated as PR #765, but its branch-bundle failure was caused by the same Search 2.0 desktop overflow now fixed in #767. Recreate that footer release from the post-#767 main baseline before merging.
Production deploy for #767 is currently running; do not mark production evidence green until the existing deploy/live checks complete.
HIGH-risk Metrika, external lead transport, Tourvisor contracts, pricing semantics and the AnyTour logo remain untouched.
